facebook_recovery.test_text: Prueba técnica P4: recuperación de comentario Facebook.

operator_ui_fix.problem: Multiple recoverable events had indistinguishable labels, requiring the operator to identify the exact resource before action.
operator_ui_fix.change: Show event kind, ID, timestamp and bounded text preview; the server omits text without inbox.read or when Inbox is disabled. Raw provider payload is not returned.

cancelled_retry_check.observation: The native confirmation blocked tab controls and was dismissed with Escape. The failure remained unchanged at one attempt. This is a cancellation, not proof that a retry guard executed.

external_deletion_gap.interpretation: The owner deleted the comment, but no matching deletion event was observed. Generic object-access rejection alone cannot be treated as authoritative proof of deletion by the application. Needs explicit source reconciliation and an honest unavailable/changed state; no local deleted flag or fake webhook was manufactured.

instagram.final_account: connected, verified; webhook and credentials unchanged

diagnostic_limits: A first read-only comparison across differently collated PostgreSQL text columns failed with 42P22; the diagnostic was repeated with sequential parameterized reads. No application writes or repair SQL were used.
The native-confirmation retry check was cancelled, so it is not credited as execution of a retry guard. Existing local failure/uncertainty regressions are distinct from live provider effects.
No forced lost-response outbound POST, shared credential revocation or institutional backup restore was performed.
